objective: Implement Ruling D58: a plan that is not ready still stops the run, and now asks the requester. Its blockers come back typed as the run's questions, GET /api/workflows/{id} returns them, and POST /api/workflows/{id}/answers starts a new run of the same workflow with the answers in its request. Free work; no paid call and no schema change.
evidence: THE TASK FILE: .orchestration/prompts/ARCH-20261029-130.md. It has 10 ordered tasks, each with exact edits, a CHECK and its EXPECT. The advisor replayed every task from the task file's own text on a copy of main on 2026-10-29, and each EXPECT is the output it saw. Where this file and the task file differ in detail, the task file governs.
THE STARTUP PROMPT: .orchestration/prompts/STARTUP.md. A new executor reads it first.

Ruling D58: docs/reviews/2026-10-29-d58-a-plan-that-is-not-ready-asks.md. Section 1 says what is wrong: a not-ready plan ends the run blocked and asks nothing in a typed form; the blockers live only in the reason string, and the requester has no way to answer and go on. Section 3 says where each change goes.

The code it changes: autornd/graph/spec.py (Node.asks_requester); autornd/graph/executor.py (ExecutionState.questions, _decide_gate, _asked); autornd/engine/workflow.py (the questions record); autornd/api/routes.py (WorkflowDetail.questions, _last_record, the answers route); workflows/full-team.yaml and workflows/lean.yaml (one line on plan_ready).
Convention 18: no call is added. Answering starts a new run, which is admitted and bounded like every other run (D58 section 6).

include: workflows/full-team.yaml and workflows/lean.yaml: the plan_ready gate only
tests/test_plan_asks.py (new); tests/test_workflow_choice.py as the task file gives it
exclude: Any real provider call. The network guard stays at 0
autornd/database.py and autornd/models/: no schema change. If one is needed, STOP and report
autornd/evals/: unchanged. The eval runner's record does not write the questions yet (D58 section 5)
Every other workflow file and every other node of full-team.yaml and lean.yaml
The plan prompt: prompt text that steers judgment needs its own ruling (D58 section 5)
docs/reviews/ and the other records; .orchestration/ except the response file
.env and .env.tier3: the owner's (G-3). Do not read them

constraints: STARTUP FIRST: the executor reads .orchestration/prompts/STARTUP.md before Task 0, and its rules hold for every task.
THE CLONE: every task runs in /home/jb/autornd-os_clone. Task 0 starts there.
FREE. No paid call. The network guard stays at 0.
TYPED, NEVER PROSE: the questions are the plan's typed blockers, read through a dotted path. Nothing reads the reason string to find them.
THE STATUS DOES NOT CHANGE: a not-ready plan still ends the run blocked with the reason it has today. The questions are a record field beside it.
A REFUSAL LEAVES NOTHING: every refusal of the answers route comes before the run gate, so it holds no slot and leaves no row.
BYTES EXACT: copy every find and replace block character for character. A copy that differs by any character is a deviation to report.
A defect found in existing harness code while doing this is a STOP-and-report, not a fix.
acceptance_criteria: (a) A not-ready plan's run ends blocked with its reason unchanged, and GET /api/workflows/{id} returns its blockers as questions, empty ones dropped, in full-team and in lean. Break-proofs 7.2 to 7.4, 7.8 and 7.9.
(b) A ready plan's run has no questions, and a gate with nothing to ask asks nothing. Break-proof 7.5.
(c) Answering starts a new run of the same workflow; its request carries each question and answer, its plan prompt contains them, and its answers record names the parent. Break-proofs 7.14 to 7.17.

(d) The refusals: 404 for a missing run or another caller's, 409 for a run that asked nothing or whose workflow is not recorded, 422 for a wrong number of answers or an empty one, each leaving no row and holding no slot. Break-proofs 7.10 to 7.13 and 7.19.
(e) The spec refuses asks_requester on a node that is not a gate; a missing path or a value that is not a list raises. Break-proofs 7.1, 7.6 and 7.7.
(f) Every workflow with a plan_ready gate declares asks_requester: plan.blockers. Break-proof 7.18.
(g) Unchanged elsewhere. Every existing test passes, changed only as the task file gives: one test in tests/test_workflow_choice.py.
(h) Counts re-derived from pytest --collect-only in HANDOVER.md, README.md and AGENTS.md; tests/test_docs.py passes. Suite green before and after, network guard 0, CI 5/5, PR opened.

rollback: Revert the PR. No schema change. Questions and answers records written meanwhile stay in the database as ordinary phase rows and are no longer read; runs started by an answer stay ordinary runs.
deliverable: One PR from branch exec/20261029-130-plan-asks, made from main: the gate's ask, the questions on the API path, the answers route, the two workflow lines, the tests with their break-proofs, the docs and counts, and the response marked DONE. Then STOP.
assumptions: A plan's blockers are written as things the planner needs to know. If they read as statements rather than questions, the requester still sees them typed and can answer them; asking the plan prompt to phrase them as questions is a separate ruling (D58 section 5).
